body:
Adds `research/compute-procurement` (white paper, stdlib-only code, 9 tests, results), plus README and portfolio page entries.

Findings (costs U[0,1]): the truthful k-unit threshold auction pays exactly k(k+1)/(n+1), which is 2× the winners' true cost for all n, k. The optimal reserve is exactly v/2. The pay-as-bid equilibrium matches VCG revenue.
